You acknowledge that Soundscape (1) is not designed, intended, or made available as a medical device, and (2) is not designed or intended to be a substitute for professional medical advice, diagnosis, treatment, or judgment and should not be used to replace or as a substitute for professional medical advice, diagnosis, treatment, or judgment.

Safety Notice

Soundscape is a navigation aid and should not be used in lieu of mobility skills, being aware of your surroundings, and good judgement. Use caution when navigating your environment as the mapping data incorporated into the Soundscape program is captured from a third-party program, and therefore, there may be limitations with the accuracy of the information presented.

source:
This is a major update to Soundscape.

Travel mode is much improved. When you travel by car or bus, Soundscape now calls out road numbers, your direction of travel, and nearby settlements. It also calls out when you cross rivers, canals, firths, and bays. Please update your offline maps to get these new features. Bus stop descriptions are now much better for users in the UK.

Sleep mode can now wake automatically when it detects that you are moving again. You no longer need to remember to wake it yourself.

We reorganized the underlying code so that we can build an iOS app from the same code. This means that in the future, we can release an iOS app with all of the features we have built for Android.

Please continue to report any problems, however small, through Contact Support in the main menu.
current: Esta es una actualización importante de Soundscape. El modo de viaje ha mejorado mucho. Cuando viajes en coche o autobús, Soundscape ahora anuncia los números de carretera, tu dirección de desplazamiento y las localidades cercanas. También avisa cuando cruzas ríos, canales, estuarios y bahías. Actualiza tus mapas sin conexión para disponer de estas nuevas funciones. Las descripciones de las paradas de autobús son ahora mucho mejores para los usuarios del Reino Unido. El modo de suspensión ahora puede reactivarse automáticamente al detectar que vuelves a moverte. Ya no necesitas acordarte de reactivarlo tú mismo. Hemos reorganizado el código subyacente para poder crear una aplicación para iOS a partir del mismo código. Esto significa que en el futuro podremos lanzar una aplicación para iOS con todas las funciones que hemos creado para Android. Sigue informándonos de cualquier problema, por pequeño que sea, a través de la opción Contacto con soporte del menú principal.

reason: All 10 line breaks (paragraph breaks) of the English were dropped, so the release notes are one run-on paragraph; splitReleaseNotes() uses paragraph breaks. Text unchanged, breaks restored.

%1$s (destination) and %3$s (road) are map names after bare prepositions; ES-G2 says map-name prepositions must be wrapped so the article is added («entrada principal del Hospital Italiano desde la calle Mayor»).
%1$s is a map name after bare «de»; wrap it per ES-G2 so «de El Corte Inglés» becomes «del Corte Inglés».

Road names in %2$s/%3$s get no article («une Calle Mayor con Avenida X»), unlike every other confected name (ES-G2). The «entre … y …» form, as in street_description_between, lets the resolver add them: «Sendero entre la calle Mayor y la avenida X». Rewording, so worth a native check.

reason: This is a contentDescription (label), like its sibling location_detail_full_screen_hint «Poner el mapa…», not a 'Double tap to' fragment; the lowercase «salir» is inconsistent.

«Aldea» means a very small rural settlement (closer to Hamlet, which is «Caserío»); a Spanish village is usually «pueblo», but «Pueblo» is taken by osm_town. Worth a native look at the Town/Village/Hamlet ladder (e.g. Town «Localidad», Village «Pueblo»).
«Señal» is also the Audio Beacon term throughout, so a callout of a railway/traffic signal can sound like the beacon. Already open in es.md for a human.
